messages.subject: Linejoins in legend
parts:
Hi all,

is there a way to have mitre linejoins in the legend? All I get is rounded corners. If I pass linejoin='mitre' to guide_legend, it gets ignored (as promised in the man page). If I pass it to the element_rect call() for legend.key, it raises an error about an unused argument.

Paul
